hero_title: Merge JW Library backups privately in your browser
hero_desc: Merge, browse, and edit your JW Library notes, highlights, and bookmarks — entirely in your browser. Your files never leave your device.
feat_local_desc: All merging happens in your browser via WebAssembly. No server. No uploads. Complete privacy.
feat_tags_desc: Intelligently combine tags, highlights, bookmarks and margin notes across all your backups.
feat_date_desc: Extract content from a specific backup date to restore exactly what you had at any point in time.
feat_browse_desc: Search your entire library, edit notes, manage tags, change highlight colours, then download the updated backup.
feat_review_desc: See exactly which notes were edited on more than one device and choose which version wins — no black box.
footer_tagline: JW Sync processes all data locally — your files never leave your device.
svc_merge_d: Combine JW Library backups from all your devices into one.
svc_explorer_d: Search, edit, tag and organise every note in a backup.
svc_stats_d: See your study streaks, totals and trends over time.
svc_share_d: Send notes to a friend, or add notes they sent you.
svc_doctor_d: Free health check — find and fix duplicates, empty notes and clutter.
svc_reading_d: Follow a daily Bible reading plan — with your own notes beside you.
